$commentaire: Essai D1 demandé le 28 octobre : référence de menu de collection, analyses automatiques distinctes de l'écoute humaine. Une seule génération, même plafond cumulé 14000.

directions.label: D1 — Collection lumineuse
directions.description: Menu électronique doux : claviers et synthés arrondis, nappes, basse et groove discret. Phrase développée sur 90 secondes.
directions.prompt: Compose an original 90-second instrumental background cue for a polished mobile card-collection menu. Warm, clear, playful and quietly uplifting electronic production, relaxed mid-tempo around 110 BPM in 4/4. A rounded, soft digital keyboard / plucked synth lead carries a graceful melody in longer 8-bar question-and-answer phrases. Gentle electric piano chords and airy warm pads support it; a clean rounded synth bass and a small restrained electronic drum groove keep it moving, with delicate syncopated hi-hat or shaker details. Keep the melody soft and spacious, never piercing, never a raw oscillator beep. This is intimate menu music at low listening volume: no big dance-floor kick, no EDM drop, no epic swell. Develop the writing throughout the full 90 seconds: introduce a clear melodic idea; answer it with a different phrase; vary its rhythm and accompaniment; move to a related contrasting middle idea; return with small melodic ornaments and a changed voicing. Do not repeat a tiny two-bar hook for the entire track. Preserve an even, comfortable energy with natural breathing room for card sound effects. Start musically rather than with a long intro; end on harmony and texture compatible with the opening so a loop can be prepared. Create entirely new melodies and musical identity; do not quote, interpolate or reproduce any existing game theme.
